title: 끊고 나서
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Hip-Hop track featuring a prominent funk-influenced electric bassline playing syncopated sixteenth-note patterns. The arrangement uses a dry, punchy drum kit with a crisp snare and tight hi-hats. A clean, rhythmic electric guitar performs muted staccato chords on the off-beats. Male vocals alternate between rhythmic rapping and melodic singing in a mid-to-high tenor range. Occasional synth stabs and subtle atmospheric pads appear in the background. The tempo is 105 BPM in the key of G minor.
